## Import libraries 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)   # reading, cleaning, ggplot2 charts
library(countrycode) # matches country names and codes across datasets
library(janitor)     # clean_names() tidies messy column names
library(scales)      # nicer axis labels on charts
library(knitr)       # kable() for neat tables

```

## Import data

```{r}
list.files("data/raw")
df <- read_csv("data/raw/v-dem_coarm_data.csv") |> clean_names()
glimpse(df)

```

quick summary check

```{r}
summary(df)
df |> count(year)
df |> filter(is.na(eu_coarm_arms_exports_eur)) |> count(country_name)

```

Top recipients

```{r}
df |> group_by(country_name) |>
  summarise(total = sum(eu_coarm_arms_exports_eur, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  slice_max(total, n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(total / 1e9, reorder(country_name, total))) +
  geom_col() + labs(x = "EU arms exports, bn EUR", y = NULL)

```

```{r}
dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)

p_top <- df |> group_by(country_name) |>
  summarise(total = sum(eu_coarm_arms_exports_eur, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  slice_max(total, n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(total / 1e9, reorder(country_name, total))) +
  geom_col() + labs(x = "EU arms exports, bn EUR", y = NULL)

ggsave("output/top_recipients.png", p_top, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p_top
```

exports vs democracy

```{r}
df |> group_by(country_name) |>
  summarise(exports = mean(eu_coarm_arms_exports_eur, na.rm = TRUE),
            democracy = mean(v2x_libdem, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(democracy, exports + 1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .6) + scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Liberal democracy index", y = "Avg yearly exports, EUR (log)")

```
